title: Wire Simulator
description: The Among Us wire task in Minecraft
body:
A Minecraft map that lets you experience the wire task minigame from Among Us, while also adding in options like a game difficulty switcher that changes how many wires you have to connect, an endless mode, and a speedrun mode that changes how you play!
